en.html:
The stairs were longer than expected.

A gentle descent, though, sometimes becoming a level passage. For all the time spent walking, we should not have gone very deep.

Nor had we gone beyond the house above. Muramasa said we were merely being taken round and round. ...The design intention escaped me.

Several minutes later, at last, I reached what appeared to be a room.

Here.

Not that I could make anything out in the dark. But I knew. My skin understood the simple fact.

Silver Star was here.

...No rash moves. If Silver Star was nearby, this was a tiger's hunting ground. Those sharpened claws could come at any moment.

I quieted my mind and stepped inside. Caution upon caution. I had to search—
